messages:
anya: Heads up — Partner Atlas reported their hourly batch totals diverged from our billing window. We see a checksum mismatch on two compressed batch files for 2026-03-20 08:00-09:00 UTC. Sample batch ids: atlas-batch-20260320-08-01, atlas-batch-20260320-08-57. Attaching snippet.

samir: :eyes: Can you paste the validation log or error lines?

anya: validation log excerpt:
```
INGEST_VALIDATE atlas-batch-20260320-08-01.gz -> checksum mismatch (expected: 8f3a2c, actual: 3a2c8f)
INGEST_VALIDATE atlas-batch-20260320-08-57.gz -> checksum mismatch (expected: b1d4e7, actual: e7d4b1)
Trace: decompression OK, canonicalization step failed at newline normalization
```

marketplace-bot: ingestion-validate job FAILED for atlas-batch-20260320-08-01.gz (job id: iv-7892)

marco: Partner-side note: we rotated our aggregator last week and bumped gzip flags for faster compression. They claim payload bytes (post-decompress) are identical. I'll confirm binary diffs.

lindsey: From billing POV, if those hours are dropped we underbill. Any idea on how many customers affected or reserved-plan exposure?

anya: Quick triage plan: 1) confirm whether decompressed payloads are byte-equal, 2) re-run decompression with legacy gzip handling, 3) recompute checksums using alternate normalization, 4) if payloads match, mark comparator tolerant and reprocess. I'll own 1-3.

olivia: Can we surface this on the partner dashboard? CSM should be aware. If it looks customer-visible we should open an incident bridge.

samir: Repro steps I'm running locally: 
```bash
python tools/recompute_checksum.py --file atlas-batch-20260320-08-01.gz --mode legacy-gzip --normalize-newlines=lf
```
If that yields expected checksum, we can re-run the reprocess job without partner reupload.

marco: I'm pulling raw uncompressed payloads and aggregator metadata now, sending to /secure/dropbox within 25m. Will include aggregator version and gzip flags.

anya: Action items and owners:
- anya: reprocess & compare decompressed payloads (ETA 1h)
- samir: implement tolerant checksum comparator & unit tests (ETA 5h)
- marco: provide raw payloads + aggregator meta (ETA 30m)
- lindsey: draft billing holdback note & tracking spreadsheet (ETA 2h)

marketplace-bot: created ticket PART-4121: "Atlas hourly batch checksum anomaly" and scheduled reprocess job (job id: reproc-441). Link: https://redwood.atlassian/issue/PART-4121

olivia: Ops note: set canary to NOT commit credits for those two batches until reprocess verification passes.

samir: Longer term: we should update the spec to allow gzip header variants and add an idempotent batch token (so duplicates are detectable even if checksum changes). I'll add a draft doc after triage.

anya: Great. I'll post progress updates here. Tagging @here for visibility. :thumbsup:
